scripts.dev: npm run generate && concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:pages: npm run generate && npm run build:pages -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run generate && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:pages: npm run build:pages && npm run test:pages -w client
